searchText: hi, I'd appreciate it if anybody could share a faucet where I can get some test ETHs on `EIP-4844 Devnet`, tried to use https://eip4844-faucet.vercel.app/ 1 hour ago but did not receive any tokens yet Is `BlobsBundleV1` in https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/experimental/blob-extension.md#blobsbundlev1 meant to bea compatible with minimal-preset EIP-4844 as defined in https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/presets/minimal/eip4844.yaml where `FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB: 4`, which leads to a `Blob` according to https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/eip4844/polynomial-commitments.md#custom-types having a length of `4 * 32`, not `4096 * 32`? If it is, how? If it's not, is that documented somewhere, and what's the intended error fallback? I dont think the minimal preset will work as of today. How does 1.) CL signals EL or 2.) user input EL client to use minimal config? so right now, EIP4844 is mainnet-preset only? Yep okay (my answers to those questions would be, by separately configuring each, the way networks are configured to be compatible in general) But I believe there's minimal spec test which tests `4 * 32` if you are interested yes, the `consensus-spec-tests` repo includes tests based on `4 * 32`, and Nimbus passes those fine it's hooking them up to the engine API which is causing issues but, alright, for now will just treat this as mainnet-only As for the point evaluation precompile, we do not check length of data passed to it to be exactly 192 bytes, right? We're using `c-kzg-4844/src/trusted_setup.txt` as our trusted setup, correct? that's right. It's also in JSON at https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/presets/mainnet/trusted_setups/testing_trusted_setups.json Spec only needs the input to be at least 192 bytes. But we probably should update it to check that it's exactly 192 bytes.
